propositions: Negative caplog assertions (assert not ...) pass vacuously when zero records are captured, providing no coverage signal and hiding silent log delivery failures

Logger propagation disabled globally (propagate=False) or logger level raised (setLevel(WARNING)) blocks log records from reaching caplog, making downstream assertions unreachable without visible failure
Test execution order and pytest worker distribution determine whether an assertion is live or void in the same commit, making coverage non-reproducible
An autouse fixture guard that snapshots and restores logger.propagate and logger.level state per test converts silent fail-open into loud fail-closed detection at the source
Five negative caplog assertions across the suite were found live via instrumentation when the propagate vector was absent, and all five fail red when injected with forbidden records
